text: A Wrong Remembered
A settlement has been attacked. Powers nearby who already had reason to hate the attacker have taken note, and their opinion of them has worsened.
They will not forget it. The grudge now colours every dealing they have with the attacker.
Common Cause
Two powers that share an enemy have signed a defensive alliance. Each will now answer if the other is attacked.
The attacker now faces two swords where yesterday there was one.
A Convoy Seized
An army has seized a convoy of goods on the road. Powers nearby who already had reason to hate the raider have taken note, and their opinion of them has worsened.
Word travels the trade roads faster than any cart, and it loses nothing in the telling.
The Faithful Turn Away
Your armies have spilled the blood of your own kin, and your temple has heard of it. Your Reputation with the temple has fallen.
The priests forgive slowly. What was lost must be earned back in the temple's service.
Vultures Gather
Your realm has split, and its neighbours have noticed. Powers that already counted you an enemy now think even less of you.
A divided realm is a tempting one, and its enemies are always the first to see the cracks.
A Restless World
The powers of this world answer bloodshed in waves. For a time they are quick to take offence and band together against an aggressor, then they settle for a while before stirring again.
Watch for the calm. It never lasts.
A Patient World
The powers of this world are slow to anger. Most wrongs pass with little said, but every so often they turn on an aggressor together.
A long silence is not the same as forgiveness.
A Fickle World
The powers of this world cannot be predicted. One wrong goes unremarked, and the next sets half the region against the aggressor.
Nobody knows what they will do next, least of all you.
Blood in the Water
Your enemy has lost ground, and the powers around it have noticed. Those who already counted it an enemy have turned against it too.
A wounded beast draws more than one hunter.
An Oath Broken
A treaty has been broken, and the powers nearby have noticed. Those who already distrusted the oath-breaker now think even less of them.
Word of a broken oath travels faster than any army.
